parameters.name: NextHop
parameters.description:
The ID of the next hop connection.

> If you want to query information about the prefix list that is used to generate blackhole routes, set this parameter to **BlackHole**.

parameters.name: NextHopInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance that is associated with the next hop connection.

parameters.name: NextHopType
parameters.description:
The next hop type. Valid values:

- **BlackHole**: queries the prefix lists that generate blackhole routes.

- **VPC**: queries the prefix lists whose next hop is a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) connection.

- **VBR**: queries the prefix lists whose next hop is a virtual border router (VBR) connection.

- **TR**: queries the prefix lists whose next hop is an inter-region connection.

parameters.name: OwnerUid
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the prefix list belongs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: PrefixListId
parameters.description: The ID of the prefix list.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the transit router.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the prefix list.

- **Active**: The prefix list is active.

- **Updating**: The prefix list is being updated.

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the transit router.

parameters.name: TransitRouterTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table of the transit router.
